potential_representation: Mode-selectable derivative polynomial or PCHIP interpolation inside the ab initio interval with confining quadratic endpoint tails
probability_normalization: integral P(s) ds = 1 with ds in bohr
phase_space_model: positive separable product of independently sampled coordinate and momentum marginals; no anharmonic Wigner quasiprobability
future_sampling: sample s and p_s independently; convert s to angstrom; invert s(Q); recover curvilinear Cartesian geometry and project p_s to Cartesian velocities
